title: Remove cookie banner from Portal and Explorer
body:
- Remove cookie banner from Portal, Explorer, and original cellxgene repo
- Also update Datadog to remove the step of "clicking on the cookie banner" on the tests.
- Some smoketests will need to be deleted.
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: we should move this issue to single-cell-data-portal, correct?

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
Oh great catch, @atolopko-czi !

Hmm this one is tricky, since it spans three repos 😆 

Not sure which repo we use to capture cross repo work 🤔

CC: @maesen @brianraymor 

Thank you!

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
Also do we need to update Terms of Service and Privacy pages now that we're removing the cookie banner? Thanks!

CC: @brianraymor

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body:
Good question. This change should have no impact on the Terms of Service only the Privacy Policy?

We had approval from Shawn to move to plausible.io but did not receive an updated privacy policy. Let me see if they've already done this for napari.

comments.author: Participant 4
comments.body:
> Hmm this one is tricky, since it spans three repos 😆
> 
> Not sure which repo we use to capture cross repo work 🤔


It should be modeled as an epic in single-cell with child Dev issues from each repo.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: Ahh that makes sense! Thanks so much, Brian 🚀!

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
NOTE TO SELF: Update Datadog once deployed to prod

> Also update Datadog to remove the step of "clicking on the cookie banner" on the tests.

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body:
